data.description: From Gerrit 1843 PS3 LLM-Review advisories (non-blocking). Two related fail-closed nuances in src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/runtime.py: (1) build_backend is asymmetric — _build_cloud calls assert_cloud_scope_ready(s) at build, but _build_datacenter defers all validation to the lazy _LazyDataCenterClient (by design, so composing needs no [agents] extra/JIRA_PAT). Decide whether the DC path should assert non-secret scope readiness (url/project) at build for symmetry while keeping PAT/network lazy. (2) assert_cloud_scope_ready enforces JIRA_USER-must-be-email and non-empty query_project, which the legacy ambient assert_env_ready does not — the same JiraBackend fails-closed differently by path. These stricter checks catch real misconfigurations (email is required for Cloud Basic auth; empty project would query every project), and real Cloud deployments satisfy them, so this is deferred as a deliberate parity decision rather than rushed into S2. Choose: keep stricter (document as intended tightening) or relax to match legacy.
data.title: RP-04 follow-up: align reconciler Cloud/DC fail-closed symmetry and scope-vs-ambient readiness parity
